designationHistory.name: Kirwin National Wildlife Management Area
designationHistory.indexText: The Kansas Forestry, Fish and Game Commission and the Secretary of the Interior approved a general plan for wildlife management of the Kirwin Reservoir lands in Phillips County, Kansas, creating an overlay refuge on a Bureau of Reclamation project.

authority.citation: General plan under the Act of August 14, 1946 (Fish and Wildlife Coordination Act); FWS notice of establishment, 20 FR (June 7, 1955)

designationHistory.note: FWS CCP: established 1954; the Federal Register notice (an FWS notice) cites the general plan approved June 17, 1954. Called the first national wildlife refuge in Kansas by FWS (superlative not checked). The govinfo copy of the June 7, 1955 Federal Register would serve as a check but is an FWS-authored notice.
